mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 63 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park and a Waning Crescent moon visible.
The City of Verona continues its partnership with AECOM for engineering reports, and the Senior Center is currently offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.
Today features Live Music at Bailey's Run and the Girls Try Hockey event at the Ice Arena, while tomorrow you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness.
On July 31, an officer performed a stop that resulted in a passenger being cited for possession of T H C and drug paraphernalia.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Snickers Swirl. Please note that Culver's is currently closed, but they will reopen at 10:00 AM.
